channel.title: PkgWatch: suspicious packages on npm and PyPI
channel.description: PkgWatch statically analyses newly published npm and PyPI packages and lists the ones that look suspicious. Entries are leads for human review, not verdicts.

item.title: [HIGH 72] suspicious pypi package: yt-dlp 2026.11.21.232659.dev0
item.description:
Risk score 72/100 (high).

  • Code reads credential, browser, chat-token or wallet files and also makes network calls in the same file.
  • URL with a raw IP address instead of a hostname.
  • Long high-entropy string literal (entropy above 5.0 bits per character). (in 5 files)
